extDesc.message: Organize your Google Classroom classes with tags, search, filters and sorting.

drag_locked_hint.message: To rearrange classes manually, switch back to “Classroom order” and clear the search and filters.

modal_empty.message: There are no tags yet. Create the first one above.

modal_priority_on.message: Priority tag: shown first on classes. Among several priority tags, the order in which they were assigned to each class is kept (click to remove)

modal_priority_off.message: Mark as priority: it will be shown first on classes. Among several priority tags, the order in which they were assigned to each class is kept

modal_delete_confirm_msg.message: Are you sure you want to delete the tag "$1"? This action cannot be undone and it will be removed from all your classes.

modal_delete_affects_one.message: It will be removed from 1 class.

modal_delete_affects_other.message: It will be removed from $1 classes.

error_tag_exists.message: A tag with that name already exists.

filter_mode_and_hint.message: Classes with all the selected tags

filter_mode_or_hint.message: Classes with any of the selected tags

filter_no_results.message: No classes match the search or filters.

selection_hint.message: Click to select · Shift+click for a range · Esc to exit

search_help.message: Searches class names and their tags, ignoring case and accents. Also matches parts of words (“tic” finds “Mathematics”). With several words, all of them must appear, in any order.

import_msg.message: Choose which parts of the file will replace the current ones:

import_opt_tags_desc.message: Names, colors and priority tags ($1 tags)

import_opt_classes_desc.message: Which tags each class has ($1 classes)

import_opt_prefs_desc.message: View order, filter mode (AND/OR) and language

import_error_format_msg.message: The file does not look like a Classroom Organizer backup.

import_error_read_msg.message: The JSON file could not be read.

storage_meter_help.message: Chrome Sync space used by your tags and their assignment to classes. Chrome allows about 100 KB per extension; if it fills up, changes stop syncing.

storage_warning.message: Synced storage is at $1%. If it fills up, changes will stop syncing.

sync_error.message: Your latest changes could not be synced (storage full or Chrome Sync error). Export a backup so you don't lose them.

dev_mode_warning_msg.message: If you uninstall the extension, your tags may be deleted from your Google account. Export a backup (↓ button above) before uninstalling it or switching to the Chrome Web Store version.

filter_empty_hint.message: To get started, hover over a class and press its tag button, or create your tags in “Manage tags”.
